snippet.title: Japanese Sonic 3 Commercial from Sonic Jam [Perfect Rip]
snippet.description: This is a Japanese Sonic 3 commercial from Sonic Jam. I like all the cheesy 90's cheap special effects. This is a "perfect rip" from the original TrueMotion v1 video on the disc.
